title: Disappointment at First Glance
prompt: Describe why some people feel disappointed when they first see the Mona Lisa.
hint: Think about the initial impression and compare it to other famous paintings.
sample: Some people are disappointed because the Mona Lisa lacks the wow factor and drama that other paintings have.

ja.prompt: モナリザを初めて見た時に失望する人がいる理由を説明してください。
ja.hint: 最初の印象や他の有名な絵画と比べて考えてみましょう。
ja.sample: モナリザは他の絵画のような派手さやドラマ性がなく、最初はがっかりする人もいます。

local.prompt: Describe why some people feel disappointed when they first see the Mona Lisa.
local.hint: Think about the initial impression and compare it to other famous paintings.
local.sample: Some people are disappointed because the Mona Lisa lacks the wow factor and drama that other paintings have.

zh.hint: 思考最初的印象，並與其他著名畫作比較。
zh.sample: 有些人感到失望是因為蒙娜麗莎缺乏其他畫作的震撼力和戲劇性。

en.prompt: Describe why some people feel disappointed when they first see the Mona Lisa.
en.hint: Think about the initial impression and compare it to other famous paintings.
en.sample: Some people are disappointed because the Mona Lisa lacks the wow factor and drama that other paintings have.

title: Leonardo's Techniques
prompt: Explain two painting techniques Leonardo da Vinci used in the Mona Lisa.
hint: Focus on how he created depth and softness in the painting.
sample: Leonardo used 'sfumato' to blend colors softly and 'chiaroscuro' to contrast light and dark for three-dimensional effects.

ja.prompt: レオナルド・ダ・ヴィンチがモナリザで使った二つの絵画技法を説明してください。
ja.hint: 絵に深みと柔らかさを出す方法に注目しましょう。
ja.sample: レオナルドは色の境目をぼかす『スフマート』と、明暗の対比で立体感を出す『キアロスクーロ』を使いました。

local.prompt: Explain two painting techniques Leonardo da Vinci used in the Mona Lisa.
local.hint: Focus on how he created depth and softness in the painting.
local.sample: Leonardo used 'sfumato' to blend colors softly and 'chiaroscuro' to contrast light and dark for three-dimensional effects.

zh.prompt: 說明達文西在蒙娜麗莎中使用的兩種繪畫技法。
zh.hint: 著重於他如何創造畫面的深度與柔和感。
zh.sample: 達文西使用了『煙霧法』來柔和地混合顏色，以及『明暗對比法』來創造立體效果。

en.prompt: Explain two painting techniques Leonardo da Vinci used in the Mona Lisa.
en.hint: Focus on how he created depth and softness in the painting.
en.sample: Leonardo used 'sfumato' to blend colors softly and 'chiaroscuro' to contrast light and dark for three-dimensional effects.

title: Mona Lisa's Smile Illusion
prompt: Describe why Mona Lisa's smile appears to change when you look at her face.
hint: Consider how human vision processes central and peripheral areas differently.
sample: Her smile seems to come and go because our central vision focuses on her eyes while peripheral vision picks up shadows on her mouth.

ja.prompt: なぜモナリザの微笑みが見る角度によって変わって見えるのか説明してください。
ja.hint: 人間の視覚が中心視野と周辺視野を異なる方法で処理することを考えましょう。
ja.sample: 中心視野は目に集中し、周辺視野は口の影を捉えるため、微笑みが見えたり見えなかったりします。

local.prompt: Describe why Mona Lisa's smile appears to change when you look at her face.
local.hint: Consider how human vision processes central and peripheral areas differently.
local.sample: Her smile seems to come and go because our central vision focuses on her eyes while peripheral vision picks up shadows on her mouth.

zh.prompt: 描述為什麼蒙娜麗莎的微笑在你看她臉時會有變化。
zh.hint: 考慮人類視覺如何不同地處理中心視野和周邊視野。
zh.sample: 她的微笑似乎時隱時現，因為我們的中心視野集中在她的眼睛，而周邊視野捕捉到嘴部的陰影。

en.prompt: Describe why Mona Lisa's smile appears to change when you look at her face.
en.hint: Consider how human vision processes central and peripheral areas differently.
en.sample: Her smile seems to come and go because our central vision focuses on her eyes while peripheral vision picks up shadows on her mouth.

title: Mona Lisa's Pose Innovation
prompt: Explain how Mona Lisa's pose was different from previous portraits and why it was innovative.
hint: Think about the length of the pose and the subject's expression.
sample: Mona Lisa uses a three-quarter length pose filling the frame, showing a relaxed and self-assured expression, unlike the stiff full-length aristocratic portraits before.

ja.prompt: モナリザのポーズが以前の肖像画とどう違い、なぜ革新的だったのか説明してください。
ja.hint: ポーズの長さや被写体の表情に注目しましょう。
ja.sample: モナリザは三分の四の長さのポーズで画面を満たし、リラックスした自信に満ちた表情をしており、以前の堅苦しい全身肖像とは異なります。

zh.prompt: 說明蒙娜麗莎的姿勢如何不同於之前的肖像畫，及其創新之處。
zh.hint: 思考姿勢的長度和被畫者的表情。
zh.sample: 蒙娜麗莎採用三分之四長度的姿勢，填滿畫面，展現放鬆且自信的表情，與之前僵硬的全身貴族肖像不同。

en.prompt: Explain how Mona Lisa's pose was different from previous portraits and why it was innovative.
en.hint: Think about the length of the pose and the subject's expression.
en.sample: Mona Lisa uses a three-quarter length pose filling the frame, showing a relaxed and self-assured expression, unlike the stiff full-length aristocratic portraits before.

title: Leonardo's Scientific Approach
prompt: Discuss how Leonardo's scientific studies influenced the painting of the Mona Lisa.
hint: Consider his studies in anatomy, optics, and how they affected details like the smile and brushwork.
sample: Leonardo's anatomical studies helped him understand facial muscles for the smile, and his optics knowledge explained the smile's illusion; his brushwork created lifelike skin textures.

ja.prompt: レオナルドの科学的研究がモナリザの絵画にどのように影響したか説明してください。
ja.hint: 解剖学や光学の研究が、微笑みや筆遣いの細部にどう関係しているか考えましょう。
ja.sample: レオナルドの解剖学研究は微笑みの筋肉を理解するのに役立ち、光学の知識は微笑みの錯覚を説明し、筆遣いは生き生きとした肌の質感を生み出しました。
